Experimental_Design.Conditions: voice-label matching: own voice vs external voices (self, friend, stranger)

Block_Structure.Trial_number: Familiarization: 12 trials; Test: 216 trials (72 per block)

Trial_Structure.SOA: Familiarization: 500 ms; Test: 0 ms (voice offset to label onset)
Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: Familiarization: label first; Test: voice first

exp2.detail: Shape = speaker identity (Own = participant own voice, derived from soundfile prefix matching OriginalGorillaID; M5/M10 = external English-accented speakers from Payne et al.). Shape_Subtype = specific audio file. Own-voice assignment to identity was between-subjects (participant_assignment in raw). Accent (English) is an experiment-level feature recorded here (column removed from Clean). Task = voice-label matching (self-matching).
